trackDescription: Focuses on Slalom’s business by delivering capabilities and offerings to customers, and supports business growth through excellent delivery. Leaders in this track are accountable for ensuring the successful delivery of team projects and cultivating talent within their teams.
jobTitleSummary: Leads business strategy, operational and financial health by leading complex solutions and sponsoring Slalom initiatives. Serves as a trusted advisor who influences client strategy and guides decision-making across complex projects and organizations. Executes talent strategies and fosters a culture of critical thinking and innovation.

Deliver Exceptionally.expectation: Oversees and integrates project / program governance, driving Delivery Excellence.
Manages prioritization and deliberate tradeoffs at scale.
Accountable for risk management, balancing business, client, and operational risks.
Guides teams in developing high-quality solutions that provide long-term value and scalability; may play an active role in the Delivery Quality Review process.
Highly forward-looking, fostering a culture of critical thinking and innovation that drives differentiation and growth.
Convincingly articulates short- and long-term solution outcomes and impacts on client businesses. Institutionalizes measurement frameworks that prioritize client value realization.

Demonstrates expertise in writing with clarity and brevity, distilling complex information into executive-ready summaries and strategic recommendations for senior leaders. Effectively highlights the value and impact for clients.

Exemplifies the ability to read an audience and influence senior leaders to build trust, create accountability, and drive clear decisions in high-stakes client engagements and executive-level interactions.
Well-networked across the client organization and leadership structures to serve delivery needs; known for depth of expertise.
Serves as trusted advisor, influencing client strategy and guiding decision-making.
Drives engagement and capability teams in implementing Customer Love strategies, in particular the transformational.

Institutionalizes the use of emerging technologies (e.g., AI, AI agents) and related best practices to enhance productivity and delivery outcomes within their teams and across their domain of expertise.
Accountable for delivery and management of high-touch and complex projects across capabilities, geographies, outcomes and/or industries.
Expands the conversation beyond the immediate engagement to drive high value outcomes and cross-capability engagements.
Positions Slalom as a trusted advisor through compelling narratives that connect project impact to market trends and thought leadership.
Champions the creation of comprehensive client success stories for marketing, new business pursuits, and internal communications.

Grow Expertise.expectation: Deepens and/or broadens mastery in Functional / Technical roles (e.g., Advanced+ 2+; Expert in 1+).
Develops in Engagement roles (e.g., Delivery Solution Lead, Engagement Lead, Accountable Executive).
Develops in Pursuit Roles (e.g., Sales Solution Lead, Accountable Executive).
Develops and upskills as a People Leader.
Participates in and/or leads communities focused on capability and delivery best practices (e.g., capability-specific, Delivery Excellence, PEM SteerCo, etc.).
Optimizes knowledge management practices and the way delivery and capability teams contribute to and leverage it.
Guides the evolution of key solutions by integrating teams' delivery learnings and ensuring perspectives, offerings, and accelerators remain practical, adaptable, and high-value for clients.
Sought out for expertise internally and externally, mentoring colleagues by sharing insights and providing shadowing opportunities.
Actively develops their team's understanding of capability, solution, and/or industry trends and best practices in a way that supports Slalom and their team's strategies and ways of working.
Sponsors learning opportunities to close capability talent gaps, build emerging skills, and reskill, ensuring alignment with business needs.
Role models curiosity within the team, proactively building and leveraging wealth of capability, industry, and/or solution knowledge.

Grow Slalom.expectation: Actively leverages broad professional network of senior-level peers, experts, partners, and clients.
Identifies and implements opportunities for improving Slalom brand stewardship practices, driving innovation and high-quality brand representation.
Well-networked across capability, geography, outcome and industry leadership structures and recognized for expertise; helps other navigate communities.
Sponsors Slalom initiatives internally and/or in the community (e.g., employee resource groups, learning events); inspires participation, ownership, and innovation at all levels.
Shapes and evolves culture across capability by integrating Slalom values into business operations, leadership practices, and employee experiences.

Helps translate Slalom and capability strategy, business performance, and insights for the capability, ensuring teams' understanding. Sets capability/sub-capability strategy based on indicators of capability maturity and market demand.
Leads business strategy and planning for discipline, sub-capability, and capability, applying it in context of office or geography.

Responsible for operational and financial health of discipline or sub-capability (e.g., staffing, utilization, billable hours, team size, bill rates). Conducts semi-annual strategic review of margin by business and by level.
Educates other leaders on Slalom financial and performance KPI measurement.
Understands capability talent landscape within purview.
Responsible for capability talent strategy, processes, and decisions (e.g., talent acquisition, staffing, performance management, engagement, retention).
Contributes to sales solutioning and/or oversee pursuits, especially in the context of delivery environments.
Able to effectively oversee complex engagement financials, controls cost of service (e.g., bill rates), and mentors team members on engagement financial management best practices.
Identifies future leader needs on the team, communicates and facilitates future leader decisions on the team, and identifies growth opportunities and trajectories of relevant leaders.
Partners with Industry, Account, Market Solutions leaders to help proactively shape deals and ensure a smooth transition from sales to delivery.
Proactively identifies and relays opportunities for Slalom in a variety of delivery environments and/or areas of expertise.

Lead.expectation: Models behaviors expected of leaders and seeks feedback as a co-creative learning process that deepens mutual growth.
Co-creates and embraces change with confidence and non-attachment, committing to the best-case outcome.
Manages transformation by embedding agility, fostering change resilience, and ensuring sustained business performance.
Sets internal team vision and strategy, in alignment with Slalom's strategic priorities.
Ensures alignment between team actions and business outcomes.
Proactively shares team updates to build organizational awareness and support connection to Slalom priorities.
Understands team member career aspirations and interests, growth trajectory, engagement, and organizational impact.
Actively supports team member career development planning and helps tailor development opportunities for individual and business impact.
Anticipates future needs at Slalom and builds a strong pipeline of leaders.
Ensures directs understand performance expectations and helps leaders within people tree set and uphold performance expectations.
Proactively identifies early signs of performance gaps, ensuring leaders within people tree take action on concerns, and drives accountability.
Assess directs' performance against defined expectations and outcomes.
Leads or co-leads calibration discussions, ensuring alignment with organizational performance standards, and drives consistency in team performance evaluation and differentiation.
Creates systems and processes that help others effectively manage their energy and attention.
Empowers teams with strategies for managing ambiguity and balancing workload, navigating complex prioritization and tradeoffs.
Reflection integrates multiple perspectives; models reflection for others.
Proactively engages in career development planning, with intentional focus on current and future business leadership needs.
Models how to collaborate, mitigate bias, and lead with compassion.
Takes prompt and meaningful action to restore trust in teams, if something disrupts it.
Coaches others on how to enable productive conflict and sets up practices to anticipate and minimize unproductive conflict.

quantitativeExpectations: Personal Contribution Credit (PCC): • Low: $1.5M • Target: $2.5M • High: $3.5M+
Business Outcome Targets: Individuals will work with their leaders to determine the business outcome that makes sense for their individual situation based on market maturity & complexity.
